**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The APCN 2 agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements-purchasing obligation binding Teleglobe USA Inc.:

- **Joint procurement is not exclusivity.** The Wet Segment is procured collectively via the Supply Contract placed by the Procurement Group (¶4.4, p0120) — a consortium mechanic, not a covenant requiring us to source from a counterparty.
- **Capacity clauses run in our favour.** ¶12.20 and ¶12.22 (p0206, p0208) expressly entitle any Party to sell IRU or make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions." The interim Paragraph 12 / Annex 7 conditions govern disposition of our own allocated capacity (and relax over time); they are not restraints on buying elsewhere.
- **The only "exclusive" hit is out of scope.** ¶27.1 (p0262) "sole and exclusive remedy" is a dispute-resolution/remedy term reviewed under GOVLAW, not a restrictive covenant — flagging it here would double-count the same term.

No redline proposed, as the document already meets the preferred position.
